professor_reference.note: Exact method from professor main_28d_analysis.py: HFD28 formula + FS_FULL + locked LightGBM regressor.

methodological_notes.no_retuning: Alpha 5 never changes the frozen primary model, primary feature set, or locked hyperparameters. Newly trained models are sensitivity-only.
methodological_notes.feature_availability: Site-specific availability-matched models remove only primary features that are completely unavailable (all NaN) in that external cohort, then retrain on MIMIC with the same locked hyperparameters.
methodological_notes.pre_icu_los: Removing pre_icu_los_d addresses concern about a quasi-mechanical relationship between hospital-admission time zero and the 28-day disposition endpoint.
methodological_notes.missingness: Observed patient-level missingness burden is evaluated as a subgroup analysis using frozen primary predictions; no synthetic missingness is introduced.
methodological_notes.hfd28: HFD28 uses the exact professor formula recoverable from the provided analysis script and fields present in the frozen final datasets.
methodological_notes.home_discharge: Home-discharge sensitivity requires discharge_location. It must not be reconstructed or guessed when that field is absent from the final frozen datasets.
